semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: Source V is a subset of real Euclidean space and losses are real on V. The public lemma generalizes to arbitrary ambient type X and total real loss functions; restriction to V recovers the source, and outside-V values are unused when leaders are feasible. No geometry, convexity, compactness or probability premise is required. For EVERY positive prefix n<=T, supplied leader n lies in V and minimizes the prefix sum against EVERY u in V. Both membership and prefix argmin are premises; minimizer existence is not constructed. For T>0 this data implies V inhabited; T0 is a vacuous empty-sum extension with no condition on leader0. The auxiliary hindsight leader at prefix n includes the current loss. It is NOT the causal FTL prediction, which uses the strict past. Lemma1.2 alone produces no learner, no-regret/logarithmic rate, stochastic expectation or minimax theorem. Teaching links to those later results are not actual proof dependencies of this lemma.
